title: Make the opt-in-gated service the public entry for Git exchange execution
outcome: Make the opt-in-gated service the public entry for Git exchange execution
acceptance: External library callers cannot launch low-level exchange capture/run through public APIs without the intended service admission; exported types remain sufficient for supported service use.
The boundary documents which layer enforces read-only, opt-in and asserted attribution, with a focused boundary regression or compiler-visible API restriction.
